fee_notes: Standard Franchise Fee is $40,000 for traditional units and $20,000 for non-traditional units. During the last fiscal year, franchisees paid $5,000 to $30,000 (factors included territory size and negotiations). If the franchise term for a traditional unit is fewer than the standard 10 years, the fee is $4,000 per year or partial year in excess of six months. A $10,000 Development Fee may be credited toward the Franchise Fee. VetFran Program provides a $10,000 reduction for honorably discharged U.S. military veterans.
raw_excerpt: The Franchise Fee for traditional units is $40,000 and the Franchise Fee for Non-Traditional units is $20,000, plus any tax or other fees imposed on the Company due to the collection of the Franchise Fee. If your franchise term for a traditional unit is for fewer than the standard ten years, the Franchise Fee is $4,000 for each year or partial year in excess of six months. If the restaurant is developed in full compliance with the terms of a Development Agreement, the Development Fee of $10,000 may be applied toward the Franchise Fee. During the last fiscal year, franchisees who entered into Franchise Agreements paid Franchise Fees of $5,000 to $30,000.
